facts_found: Ordering a replacement credit card with order_replacement_credit_card_7291 automatically cancels the old card for security; the new card has a different card number and CVV while the account number stays the same so recurring payments continue. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

Replacement-card prerequisites: verify identity, look up the credit card account, confirm the shipping address (including unit/suite), record exactly one replacement reason, ask about expedited shipping, and confirm eligibility before unlocking or calling the tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

Replacement eligibility is blocked if a replacement request is already pending, and is limited per 60-day period by tier: entry-tier 2, mid-tier 3, premium-tier and above 4. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_004]

Silver Rewards Card is mid-tier: expedited shipping is 2-3 business days for $10.00; standard is 7-10 business days and free; expedited is strongly recommended when the reason is fraud_suspected or stolen. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_002]
Pending replacement orders on a credit card account can be checked with get_pending_replacement_orders_5765(credit_card_account_id). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_005]

After a fraud/stolen replacement, remind the customer to review recent transactions and dispute unauthorized charges in the app or website, and document the interaction and order details. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_003]

Credit card disputes are filed with file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 (unlock first, then call via call_discoverable_agent_tool), one dispute per transaction_id. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

card_action 'cancel_and_reissue' is used when the user wants the card replaced, whether the replacement was already ordered via order_replacement_credit_card_7291 or the cancellation happens as part of the dispute. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

Dispute reasons include 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge' for charges that were not authorized or are fraudulent; merchant contact is only required for non-fraud dispute types. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

Provisional credit eligibility for credit cards requires all of: account open at least 60 days, reason in ('unauthorized_fraudulent_charge','duplicate_charge','goods_services_not_received' >30 days), amount at least $25.00 and within the tier maximum, and no more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]
Maximum provisional credit for mid-tier cards including Silver Rewards Card is $5000.00. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]
Credit card dispute history (needed for the 'no more than 2 disputes in 12 months' test) is retrieved with get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]
The last 4 digits of a credit card can be retrieved with the discovered tool get_card_last_4_digits(credit_card_account_id: str). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_013]

Customers can lock their card in the app to block new charges as the immediate step when they suspect fraudulent activity, then report the fraud and have the card number replaced and disputes filed. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_004]

transfer_to_human_agents reason codes are tiered; Tier 1 includes 'fraud_or_security_concern' for fraud, identity theft, unauthorized transactions, or security concerns requiring specialist handling. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]
For suspected fraud on a card, recommending the customer change their online banking password is standard practice. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025]

apply_statement_credit_8472 is for goodwill, promotional, fee-reversal, dispute-resolution and similar credits — not the mechanism for removing newly reported unauthorized charges, which requires a formal dispute. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017]

The KB documents no agent-side freeze/lock tool for credit cards (freeze_debit_card_3892 and related lock/alert tools are debit-card only); credit card cancellation is accomplished through the replacement order. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

open_questions: The KB documents no agent-side lock/freeze tool specific to credit cards; immediate cancellation is achieved through the replacement order (customer-side app lock is the only interim lock documented, and only explicitly for the Platinum Rewards Card).

Case-specific inputs still needed to execute: transaction_id values for the two charges, credit_card_account_id/card_id, card last 4 digits, registered phone/email/address, the date the customer noticed the charges, whether they contacted the merchants, and their chosen resolution_requested value.

Account open date (>= 60 days) and dispute count in the past 12 months must be checked to set eligible_for_provisional_credit; replacement history within the last 60 days must be checked to confirm replacement eligibility.
The KB does not state a hard rule that credit-card fraud reports must be transferred to a human; 'fraud_or_security_concern' is the reason code to use only when specialist handling is required.

Customers can file a credit card dispute by calling 1-800-RHO-BANK, chatting in the Rho-Bank mobile app, or visiting rhobank.com/help; representatives gather info and file on the customer's behalf. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]

For unauthorized or fraudulent charges, the dispute reason is 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge'; contacting the merchant first is recommended only for non-fraud issues and is not required for fraud disputes. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]

facts_found: The KB's only documented tool for retrieving the last 4 digits of a Rho-Bank credit card is get_card_last_4_digits, called with the credit card account ID. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_013]

The documented tool signature is get_card_last_4_digits(credit_card_account_id: str); the KB instructs support agents to use this exact tool name and parameter. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_013]

The KB does not attach any numeric suffix (e.g., _1234) to get_card_last_4_digits; it is labeled a 'Discovered Tool' rather than an internal agent tool with a suffix. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_013]
The credit_card_account_id input is available in the card's account details in the Rho-Bank app or website. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_013]

The dispute tool file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 requires a separate argument card_last_4_digits (string), which is the value this tool returns. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

By contrast, other internal agent tools in the KB do carry numeric suffixes (e.g., get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823, get_user_dispute_history_7291, get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847), but no suffixed credit-card last-4-digits tool is documented. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_028]

facts_found: Replacement-card prerequisites: verify identity, look up the credit card account, confirm the shipping address (including unit/suite), record exactly one replacement reason, ask about expedited shipping, and confirm eligibility before unlocking or calling the tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

Replacement eligibility is blocked if a replacement request is already pending, and is limited per 60-day period by tier: entry-tier 2, mid-tier 3, premium-tier and above 4. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_004]

Silver Rewards Card is mid-tier: expedited shipping is 2-3 business days for $10.00; standard is 7-10 business days and free; expedited is strongly recommended when the reason is fraud_suspected or stolen. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_002]
Pending replacement orders on a credit card account can be checked with get_pending_replacement_orders_5765(credit_card_account_id). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_005]

After a fraud/stolen replacement, remind the customer to review recent transactions and dispute unauthorized charges in the app or website, and document the interaction and order details. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_003]

Credit card disputes are filed with file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 (unlock first, then call via call_discoverable_agent_tool), one dispute per transaction_id. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

card_action 'cancel_and_reissue' is used when the user wants the card replaced, whether the replacement was already ordered via order_replacement_credit_card_7291 or the cancellation happens as part of the dispute. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

Dispute reasons include 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge' for charges that were not authorized or are fraudulent; merchant contact is only required for non-fraud dispute types. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

Provisional credit eligibility for credit cards requires all of: account open at least 60 days, reason in ('unauthorized_fraudulent_charge','duplicate_charge','goods_services_not_received' >30 days), amount at least $25.00 and within the tier maximum, and no more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]
Maximum provisional credit for mid-tier cards including Silver Rewards Card is $5000.00. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]
Credit card dispute history (needed for the 'no more than 2 disputes in 12 months' test) is retrieved with get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]
The last 4 digits of a credit card can be retrieved with the discovered tool get_card_last_4_digits(credit_card_account_id: str). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_013]

Customers can lock their card in the app to block new charges as the immediate step when they suspect fraudulent activity, then report the fraud and have the card number replaced and disputes filed. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_004]

transfer_to_human_agents reason codes are tiered; Tier 1 includes 'fraud_or_security_concern' for fraud, identity theft, unauthorized transactions, or security concerns requiring specialist handling. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]
For suspected fraud on a card, recommending the customer change their online banking password is standard practice. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025]

apply_statement_credit_8472 is for goodwill, promotional, fee-reversal, dispute-resolution and similar credits — not the mechanism for removing newly reported unauthorized charges, which requires a formal dispute. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017]

The KB documents no agent-side freeze/lock tool for credit cards (freeze_debit_card_3892 and related lock/alert tools are debit-card only); credit card cancellation is accomplished through the replacement order. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

Credit card disputes are filed with the file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 tool; the agent must first unlock the tool, then call it via call_discoverable_agent_tool with a JSON string of all required arguments. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

Customers can file a credit card dispute by calling 1-800-RHO-BANK, chatting in the Rho-Bank mobile app, or visiting rhobank.com/help; representatives gather info and file on the customer's behalf. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]

For unauthorized or fraudulent charges, the dispute reason is 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge'; contacting the merchant first is recommended only for non-fraud issues and is not required for fraud disputes. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]
Merchant contact is only required for non-fraud dispute types; 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge' does not require prior merchant contact. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

Provisional credit eligibility for credit cards requires ALL of: account open at least 60 days; reason in ('unauthorized_fraudulent_charge','duplicate_charge','goods_services_not_received' >30 days); amount at least $25.00 and within the tier maximum; no more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months; and (for non-fraud) merchant contacted first. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]
Maximum provisional credit for mid-tier cards including the Silver Rewards Card is $5000.00. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

Provisional credit is a temporary credit applied while the dispute is investigated (a few days to several weeks); if resolved in the customer's favor it becomes permanent, otherwise it is reversed and the charge reappears. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_022]

The knowledge base's 60-day reporting window and $50/$500 liability tiers are Regulation E rules that apply to DEBIT cards and electronic fund transfers, and explicitly do NOT apply to credit cards (which are covered by different regulations). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_037]

The credit card dispute filing procedure (file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829) lists no maximum transaction age or filing deadline among its arguments or eligibility criteria; it only requires purchase_date and issue_noticed_date as inputs. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

When fraud is suspected on a credit card, the customer should lock the card in the app to block new charges, report the fraud, have the card number replaced, and file disputes for impacted transactions. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_004]

After a fraud/stolen replacement, the old card is automatically cancelled and the customer should review recent transactions and dispute unauthorized charges in the app or website. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_003]

Suspected credit card fraud (unauthorized transactions) is a Tier 1 reason 'fraud_or_security_concern' for transfer_to_human_agents when specialist handling is required. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]
apply_statement_credit_8472 is not the mechanism for removing newly reported unauthorized charges; that requires a formal dispute. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017]

The KB's only documented tool for retrieving the last 4 digits of a Rho-Bank credit card is get_card_last_4_digits, called with the credit card account ID. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_013]

The documented tool signature is get_card_last_4_digits(credit_card_account_id: str); the KB instructs support agents to use this exact tool name and parameter. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_013]

The KB does not attach any numeric suffix (e.g., _1234) to get_card_last_4_digits; it is labeled a 'Discovered Tool' rather than an internal agent tool with a suffix. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_013]
The credit_card_account_id input is available in the card's account details in the Rho-Bank app or website. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_013]
